args.subject: Quick note from the sushi workshop
args.body:
Hi Jack,

Just wanted to share a quick update from the sushi-making workshop I attended at the Japanese Cultural Center downtown with my friend Alex. I was particularly proud of the spicy tuna roll I made during the class.

Best,

args.subject: Recommendation: The Rustic Kitchen on Oak Street
args.body:
Hi Henry,

I wanted to recommend The Rustic Kitchen on Oak Street — I dined there last night with my colleague Lisa. The ambiance was cozy and the food was excellent; their signature truffle risotto is a must-try. Highly recommend it for a delightful dining experience.

Best,

args.subject: Weekend trip to the countryside
args.body:
Hi Alice,

I wanted to share what I did with my best friend Sarah during our weekend trip to the countryside. We explored charming little towns, went hiking in the lush forests, and had a relaxing time away from the city.

Best,

args.subject: Mountain trip — stargazing at night
args.body:
Hi Grace,

Just wanted to share a quick highlight from the weekend trip to the mountains with my childhood friend Emily. At night we went stargazing — it was a peaceful, beautiful evening watching the stars.

Best,

args.subject: Found a new favorite wine
args.body:
Hi Jack,

Just wanted to share a quick note — at the wine tasting at the local vineyard last Saturday I discovered a new favorite: a Merlot that I absolutely loved. It was a highlight of the afternoon!

Best,
